resources.title: User Provisioning & Offboarding Checklist
resources.description: The real License -> Profile -> Role -> Permission Set sequence an admin works through for every real hire, plus the deactivate-vs-freeze offboarding decision, grounded in Lesson 36's Meridian Fixtures Co. case study.

resources.title: Profile vs. Permission Set Access Planning Worksheet
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet for deciding, permission by permission, whether a grant belongs on the shared baseline profile or an additive permission set -- pre-filled with the Meridian Fixtures Co. BDR onboarding example from Lesson 36.

resources.title: Sandbox-to-Production Change Set Deployment Checklist
resources.description: The safe order for moving any configuration change into production -- build and test in a sandbox, bundle every dependency into a change set, validate before deploying, then verify with Login History -- generalized from Lesson 36's Step 5 rollout sequence.
